ops.title: cc-sentiment release on cc-transcript v13 (Rust-only + NLP restored)
ops.description: Coordinated downstream release after cc-transcript v13.0.0 ships: bump pin to >=13,<14; delete tokenize_spans/WORD_BOUNDARY_PATTERN/local negation in highlight.py in favor of cc_transcript.nlp; restore POS noun suppression (SENTIMENT_POS/NOUN_LIKE_POS, STRONG_NEGATIVE_THRESHOLD=-3); DOMAIN_CRITICAL_TOKENS tone-gate exemption per task 15f3aba with the 3 tests re-goldened to wrong-bucket scores; remove the tests-python CI job and backend fixture python branch (Python fallback no longer exists upstream). Builds on the unlanded 871b70a migration branch.

ops.text: cc-sentiment client suite green against cc-transcript>=13 with the tests-python CI job removed
highlighter renders POS-suppressed highlights and STOP colors red in a score-4 bucket (re-goldened tests pass hermetically)
no local tokenizer/negation duplicates remain in highlight.py (consumes cc_transcript.nlp)
